creator: Kenney; Fleur Keijsers; Guus Vermeulen

review.reviewer: Codex source inspection and independent root physical-sense picture review at actual minimum Match and Memory card sizes, including cart/basket comparison

brief: Show an empty compact rigid retail shopping basket in a three-quarter view, with its raised hand-carry handle and open basket clearly visible at the actual minimum card size. Keep the handheld basket distinct from a wheeled shopping cart. Exclude wheels, fabric sides, a lid, and groceries that obscure the handle or opening. Use the inspected original Mini Market shopping-basket mesh without geometry or material changes.
adaptations: Rendered the acquired Mini Market shopping-basket mesh with its original geometry, materials and external colormap; no model parts, textures or groceries were invented.

Three-quarter view shades the raised hand-carry handle for contrast against the actual light card surface. The empty basket preserves the handle and opening; the original groceries-in-basket brief and its accepted revision are retained in provenance.
768 by 768 transparent source render, alpha-bounds crop with a 16-pixel margin, and Lanczos reduction to 512 by 454. The exact accepted PNG is retained without further conversion.

Independently inspected in actual native WordCard at Match 126 by 72 and Memory 144 by 74, unmatched and matched with the real badge and alpha tint, including side-by-side comparison with the accepted cart. This is agent picture review, not a participant recognition test; see docs/assets/professional-retail-shopping-basket.md for source history and separate delivery verification.
